theorem.statement: For the full Boolean signed-3SAT polymorphism algebra, whose term clone is the projection clone, every power A^n requires all |A|^n tuples as generators. Therefore the algebra has EGP and fails PGP/switchability.
proof: Coordinatewise application of a projection to tuples already in S returns one tuple from S.
Hence Sg(S)=S for every S subseteq A^n.
Therefore S generates A^n iff S=A^n.
For |A|=2 the minimum generator count is 2^n.
